title: DEL course manifest (written by the Course Generation Agent)
description: Hints for the Course Upload and Publishing Agent: course.manifest.json in the course folder, and optionally lesson.json in a lesson folder (lesson.json wins for that lesson; its `folder` is implied). The upload agent checks every hint against the captions, slides and lab; courses/<slug>/plan.json stays the source of truth. Standard: docs/COURSE_STANDARD.md.

description.description: Markdown; only what the videos and labs really cover.

sections.description: Suggested sections in learning order, each with its lesson folders in order.

status.description: Only `ready` lessons are uploaded; the watcher also waits for the files to settle.

role.description: `intro` = the course introduction: first lesson of section 1, free preview, course promo video.

prerequisites.description: Earlier lesson folders or skills this lesson needs (e.g. the lab it continues).

position.description: Where a learner should watch it.

resources.description: Files in the lesson folder for learners: the slides PDF and the lab ZIP (never PowerPoint).

quiz.description: The lesson's questions, the same as in the video. 3 to 5 options; `correct` is the 0-based index.
